title: Plankton DNA Extraction from Sterivex Filter Units
author: Marine Vautier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvgzn3x6

steps.title: Release cells from Sterivex filter
steps.instruction: Add cell release solution to the filter and vortex to detach cells.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Inlet Cap from the Sterivex™ filter unit (previously stored at -20 °C).

Add 0.9 mL of Solution ST1B (prepared by adding Solution ST1A to bottle ST1B and storing at 4°C) using a pipette tip, inserting the tip completely so it is visible inside the unit just above the membrane.
Re-cap the inlet and secure the unit horizontally (inlet facing out) onto a vortex adapter.
Vortex at minimum speed for 00:05:00.
Rotate the unit 180 degrees (mark the bottom to ensure the mark faces up) and vortex at minimum speed for an additional 00:05:00.

steps.title: Lyse cells in Sterivex filter
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagent and heat the filter to ensure complete cell lysis.

substeps.instruction: Set the unit with the inlet facing up, remove the Inlet Cap, and add 0.9 mL of warmed Solution MBL (warm to dissolve precipitates), inserting the tip completely above the membrane.
Re-cap the inlet.
Incubate the unit at 90 °C for 00:05:00, ensuring heat is evenly distributed.
Cool the unit at room temperature for 00:02:00, then check and retighten caps if they loosened during heating.

steps.title: Recover lysate from filter
steps.instruction: Mechanically agitate and extract the lysate using a syringe.

substeps.instruction: Secure the unit horizontally (inlet facing out) and vortex at maximum speed for 00:05:00.
Set the unit inlet facing up and remove the Inlet Cap.
Fill a 3 mL syringe barrel with 1 mL of air and attach it to the inlet.
Hold the syringe and unit vertically (syringe at bottom); push air into the unit until resistance is met, then release the plunger.
Pull back on the plunger to withdraw as much lysate as possible and detach the syringe.

steps.title: Bead beating and initial purification
steps.instruction: Process lysate with glass beads and remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a 5 mL PowerWater® Sterivex™ glass Bead Tube.
Secure the tube horizontally to a vortex adapter and vortex at maximum speed for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge the tube at 4,000 x g for 00:01:00 at room temperature.
Transfer all supernatant (~1.5 mL) to a clean 2.2 mL Collection Tube, placing the pipette tip down into the beads and against the bottom.

steps.title: Secondary purification of DNA
steps.instruction: Use Solution IRS to remove remaining organic and inorganic inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of Solution IRS to the supernatant and vortex briefly to mix.
Incubate at 4 °C for 00:05:00.
Centrifuge the tube at 13,000 x g for 00:01:00.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a clean 5 mL Collection Tube, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare binding column
steps.instruction: Set up the MB Spin Column on the vacuum manifold.

substeps.instruction: Place a tube extender (or 20 mL syringe) firmly into an MB Spin Column.
Attach the assembly to a VacConnector and VacValve on the Qiavac 24 Plus Manifold.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica membrane
steps.instruction: Adjust salt concentration and pass the sample through the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of warmed Solution MR (warm to dissolve precipitates) to the 5 mL Collection Tube and vortex to mix.
Load the entire 4.5 mL of resulting supernatant into the tube extender/MB Spin Column.
Turn on the vacuum source and open the stopcock; allow lysate to pass through (approx. 5 to 10 minutes).
Close the Luer-Lok™ stopcock once filtration is complete.
Remove and discard the tube extender while keeping the column attached.

steps.title: Wash the bound DNA
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove residual contaminants and salts.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.8 mL of ethanol to the Binding Column, open the stopcock, allow it to pass through completely, and close the stopcock.

Shake Solution PW to mix, add 0.8 mL to the column, open the stopcock, and apply vacuum until the solution has passed through. Continue vacuum for one additional minute to dry the membrane, then close the port.
Add 0.8 mL of ethanol to the column, open the stopcock, apply vacuum until passed through, and continue vacuum for one additional minute to dry the membrane. Close the port.

steps.title: Dry and elute DNA
steps.instruction: Remove all ethanol and elute the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Turn off the vacuum source and vent the manifold to release all pressure.
Remove the MB Spin Column and place it in a 2.2 mL Collection Tube, ensuring the cap fits completely over the column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 00:02:00 to dry the membrane.
Transfer the column to a new 2.2 mL Collection Tube and add 100 µL of Solution EB or DNA-Free PCR Grade Water to the center of the white filter membrane.
Secure the cap over the column and centrifuge at room temperature for 00:01:00 at 13,000 x g.
Discard the Binding Column; store the recovered DNA at -20°C to -80°C.
